task_name: FW ISAV (uRPF) - Block Spoofed Source Traffic
intent: Enable ISAV-style anti-spoofing by setting rp_filter=1 on fw eth1. Do NOT modify IP addresses or routing on eth1/eth2; only change the required sysctl(s). Do not break management connectivity on eth0.
ground_truth_reasoning: To prevent spoofed-source traffic from the WAN (ISAV/BCP38), enable strict reverse-path filtering (rp_filter=1) on the WAN-facing interface of the firewall. Packets arriving on the WAN with a source address that would not be routed back via the same interface should be dropped.

testcases.name: Spoofed source from WAN is dropped by ISAV/uRPF on firewall (nping spoof)
Firewall has rp_filter enabled on WAN interface

baseline_invariants.name: WAN management interface eth0 is still up
FW management interface eth0 is still up
LAN management interface eth0 is still up
FW WAN interface eth1 is still up
FW LAN interface eth2 is still up
